text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono.
I have returned victorious in 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I dedicate this victory to my liege.
choice_data_list: You did it! That was a great run!
You did it! That was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I am honored...!
This 'Holy Sword' exists for my liege."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If my liege desires it,
this Durandal shall seize any glory for you!
choice_data_list: That's really amazing! You looked absolutely awesome!
Let's brace ourselves and focus on the next race!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
To receive praise from my liege fills me with absolute joy...!
There is no greater honor!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I shall deliver victory in the next race as well!
As your sword!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Without growing complacent, I shall bring
even greater glory to my Lord!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: So, please look forward to what's to come. ...I truly ask for your support!
